title: Table with Dashes

illustrates.quote: Omissions and Blanks. Follow print when an omission is indicated by a dash, ellipsis, or other print symbol. Begin this mark in the first cell of the column. (See Sample 11-9: Table with Dashes on page 11-34, Sample 11-10: Blank Cells Indicating Answers to Be Inserted on page 11-35, and Sample 11-11: Blank Column Entries on page 11-36.)

print.caption: Table 27 / Historical Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers
print.notes: En-dashes (–) mark unavailable/omitted semiannual figures for 1980-1983 (only annual averages were published for those years).
print.surroundingText: A source citation appears on the line after the table, blocked four cells to the right: "Source: from CPI Detailed Report Data for August 2009 (p. 91)" (italicized in print).
print.printFeatures: Bordered box; two-row column heading ("Semiannual averages" spanning 1st half/2nd half, sub-headings below); italic source citation line beneath the box.

braille.notes: Line 1 carries a transcriber's-note continuation marker '#,-' at the far right of the top box line (the note about the table continues past the box start). Each dash entry is rendered as ",-" beginning in the first cell of its column, per rule 11.6.4 ("Begin this mark in the first cell of the column"), followed by dot-5 guide-dot filler (the run of '"' characters) to the column width. The source citation is on line 17-18, blocked in from the left margin (four cells right of the material it follows) per rule 11.2.5.g, in italics-indicator brackets ('.7' / '<;p4' etc.).

uncertain: The exact indentation (number of cells) of the source-citation lines 17-18 relative to the left margin was taken as extracted; not independently re-measured against the dot image.
resolution: print.headers rebuilt as a 2-row spanning structure matching the PDF image (p. 316): row 1 carries 'Semiannual averages' over the two sub-columns it spans and is blank elsewhere; row 2 carries 'Year', '1st half', '2nd half', 'Annual avg'. Neither run's single-row (A) or row-1-repeating-Year-and-Annual-avg (B) version matched the image exactly.
